jobs.title: Data Analyst Associate
jobs.description:
Duties And Responsibilities

Independently apply Item Data Governance standards to assigned item records and identify when data exceptions or policy questions require escalation
Manage the collection, organization, validation, and maintenance of product and item data within company systems
Create and maintain item records while helping ensure data accuracy and completeness
Independently prioritize and process product information requests, using judgment to resolve incomplete, inconsistent, or conflicting data
Learn and become proficient in ERP and PIM systems
Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned product data requests, coordinating directly with suppliers and internal stakeholders
Support inventory lifecycle activities by assisting with item status updates and data maintenance
Evaluate product documentation, and item attributes to determine whether item data is complete and accurate
Help maintain product information standards for internal and external catalogs
Support internal customer requests and departmental projects
Analyze recurring data issues or discrepancies, recommend resolution steps, and escalate complex exceptions as
Make recommendations to improve data accuracy, consistency, and completeness across systems
Identify process gaps or recurring data-quality issues and propose corrective actions appropriate
Perform other duties as assigned

Education And Experience

Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and related experience
0-2 years of experience in product data management, data analysis, product information management, supply chain, or related business systems experience preferred
Experience working with large data sets and Microsoft Office applications preferred
Exposure to Power BI, D365 ERP or PIM systems is a plus but not required
